title: The Whisper
narration: A spacecraft fifteen billion miles away whispers, but its voice fades. Voyager one, our farthest ambassador, calls from the edge of the Solar System.
visual_goal: Tiny spacecraft against stars, radio pulse

title: Leaving Home
narration: Launched September five, nineteen seventy-seven, Voyager one explored Jupiter and Saturn, revealing Io's volcanoes and new moons. In twenty twelve, it crossed into interstellar space, sending a warning about beyond our Sun's bubble.

title: The Golden Record
narration: It carries a Golden Record, curated by Carl Sagan, with sounds and images for any civilization. It may outlast every human who built it.

title: Fading Power
narration: Voyager sends unique data on plasma density that defies models. Signals take a day to arrive; power has fallen from four hundred seventy to two hundred thirty-eight watts. Still, scientists listen.

title: The Silent Emissary
narration: By ~two thousand thirty, instruments shut down, but as of two thousand twenty-six it transmits. It drifts toward Ophiuchus at thirty-eight thousand miles per hour, carrying our first hello long after we're dust.
